heroSection.description: Authorized Dealer of Somfy French Motors, Enjoy the silent and smooth operation of your blinds with our WireFree, whisper quiet motors.

aboutSection.title: Choose the right electric curtains for your project
aboutSection.content1: Somfy offers a wide range of motorized solutions to filter sunlight precisely and protect your privacy.
aboutSection.content2: The Somfy curtain motor and track can be easily integrated with all types of curtains (traditional, wave or pleat, with or without blackout). The motor is neatly concealed behind the curtain, and rails are available in any length (up to 10 m). They are suitable for left, right, and center opening curtains.
aboutSection.content3: To choose the right motor for your smart curtain, we suggest you contact a local Somfy dealer. They can explain the benefits of electric curtains and important considerations like weight, size, and length of the curtain.

featuresSection.title: Why choose a Somfy motorised smart curtain?

feature1.title: Designed for silence
feature1.description: The opening and closing of your automatic curtains is almost silent and well controlled by the Somfy motor, ensuring long-lasting protection.

feature2.title: Touch motion function
feature2.description: If you pull the curtains gently, this activates the motor, which then does the rest.

feature3.title: Adjustable speed
feature3.description: Choose a motorised curtain rail from the Glydea series and adjust the speed to meet your exact needs.
